text.p: Here are highlights from Polish newspapers this morning.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
FRONT PAGE POLITICAL NEWS
RZECZPOSPOLITA
- Poland's parliament passed four out of five acts related to the concordat agreement between Poland and the Vatican on Thursday night.

- Around 73 percent of Poles would not vote for candidates for political offices who collaborated with the communist security services while 15 percent would consider such a vote, a survey by the PBS polling institute said.
DZIENNIK PRAWA I GOSPODARKI

- "We are now constructing a great European Union in which the nations of Europe will combine their interests to allow for their better representation", Germany's president Roman Herzog said in Gdansk on Thursday.
- Poland's social security system reform has been accepted by society and politicians which is positive news, the cabinet minister responsible for the reform Jerzy Hausner said.

- Poland's President Aleksander Kwasniewski has challenged the bill on cheaper fuels for farmers in the Constitutional Tribunal saying it violates citizens' freedoms, the president's press office said.
ECONOMIC AND MARKET NEWS
RZECZPOSPOLITA
- Poland's corporate sector average net monthly salary grew by 22.4 percent in the first five month of 1997 compared with the same period last year, the cabinet economic committee KERM said.
- South Korea's Daewoo Precision Industries Ltd (DPI) will invest $40 million in the ZCS engine component plant in Ciechanow in the next three years, DPI said.
- Polish and Slovak economic ministry officials discussed areas of co-operation on international markets at a meeting in Jaworzyna, Poland's Economy Minister Wieslaw Kaczmarek said.
- Polish State Railways (PKP) will call a tender for deliveries of nine tilted trains in July, PKP said.

- Britain's United Biscuits Investments, which controls the ZPC San SA confectionery maker in Jaroslaw, southern Poland, will increase the plant's share capital to 45 million zlotys, ZPC San's president Jan Pajda said.
- The Volkswagen (VW) Poznan assembly plant will increase employment to 1,800 workers from 1,504 workers in the fourth quarter of 1997, the plant's director Adam Dobielinski said.

- Austria's Elsner Epalag firm has made the best offer to buy the bankrupt Chlodnia Elk SA refrigeration plant in northern Poland worth 1.3 million zlotys and is most likely to purchase it when permitted by the treasury ministry, the plant's receiver Marian Jan Gryko said.

- The listed Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych (BIG) has appointed Krystyna Bojarska-Zrzednicka its new board member. Previously, Bojarska-Zrzednicka was the deputy president of the Powszechny Bank Gospodarczy (PBG) in Lodz.
DZIENNIK PRAWA I GOSPODARKI

- The share capital of Westdeutsche Landesbank Polska will increase to 100 million marks from the present 50 million marks in the third quarter of this year. The bank expects to make a profit in 1997.
- The sales of the Polish branch of Ericsson telecoms equipment maker reached $40 million in 1996, the branch's president Kaj Juul-Pedersen said.
- Major software makers lost $170 million as a result of pirate software sales in Poland, a report by the Business Software Alliance said.
- The PZU SA insurance firm's supervision board president Jan Bogutyn plans to stand down at the general shareholders meeting on Monday, a source who declined to be named said.
GAZETA WYBORCZA

- Poland's Consumer and Competition Office (UOKK) has applied to the state telecommunications and post supervision body (PITIP) to inspect Telekomunikacja Polska SA (TPSA), the state-owned telecoms monopolist.
- The Belchatow brown coal mine is considering selling its stake in Petrobank in Lodz which is controlled by the Korean LG Group, a source who declined to be named said.
- Westdeutsche Landesbank has given a credit of $15 million for construction of the Polish section of the Yamal gas and oil pipeline to the Europolgaz joint venture carrying out the scheme.
PARKIET
- The listed Beton Stal construction firm will pass all its 1996 net profit of 677,269 zlotys to its reserve capital.
